remarks: Prime Norwalk Location! Welcome to this stunning and spacious second-floor apartment offering comfort, and convenience. This beautifully maintained rental features four generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms, each designed with custom Shaker-style cabinetry. Hardwood floors flow throughout the home, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The bright eat-in kitchen opens seamlessly to the sun-filled dining and living areas. A spacious sunroom provides additional flexible living space, perfect for a home office, or reading area. A convenient mudroom offers valuable additional storage and helps keep everyday life organized.  Enjoy the added convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer, along with reserved parking spaces. Conveniently located near grocery stores, restaurants, pharmacies, and a variety of everyday amenities, with easy access to the Merritt Parkway and Route 7 for commuting.
